scope: Actual canonical normal build attempts1 through12 and final successful attempt13; all failing raw logs retained, including unsuccessful proof-API variants and a removed trace_state diagnostic.
classification: Pinned API, elaboration/coercion and local omitted proof detail, plus the separately recorded repairable internal Taylor arithmetic equality error. No substantive manuscript gap identified.

module_diagnoses.P2U9DirectedRationalCover: Explicit rational coefficient casts and pinned addition orientation; expose unchanged interval aliases and normalize rational endpoint/log-density casts.
module_diagnoses.CurrentChenP5U9OriginalIntegralGap: Reuse exact existing remote 86d2a123 proof postimage: specify (μ := volume) for the interval-integrability hint.
module_diagnoses.CurrentP5CausalCellEventualAssembly: Reuse existing six Finset-to-Set carrier annotations. Old expressions were ill-typed; explicit coercion preserves the existing full finite carrier and all assumptions, conclusions and proof bodies.
module_diagnoses.P5zPositiveFamilyBudget: Type the original prime/size conjunction before if_pos; explicitly supply the existing N parameter to the prime/coprimality helper.

module_diagnoses.P5OriginalFixedDensitySupplierAssembly: Use pinned add_le_add_left for the right-added fixed error term.
module_diagnoses.P5zUpsilon9SwitchedMultiplicity: Use existing Finset membership equivalences explicitly, avoid reducible Sigma projection mismatch in q<N+1, and apply the pinned right-added cardinality inequality.
module_diagnoses.P5zUpsilon9SmallPrimeBudget: Beta-normalize the receiver-map injectivity hypothesis before omega.
module_diagnoses.P5zUpsilon9SourceMass: Normalize only the existing multiplication/division association when transporting the scaled logarithmic-integral mass bound.
module_diagnoses.CurrentChenP5U9CoprimeCorrection: Split the existing coprimality condition and close the signed Fubini coefficient identity by ring; retain arbitrary signed rho and the original domains.
module_diagnoses.P5zUpsilon9OriginalSlot: Use pinned add_le_add_left for right-added delta; retain every independent analytic input.
module_diagnoses.CurrentChenP5U9DirectedLowerCertificate: Normalize the unchanged a,b,d,logDensity rational casts explicitly.
module_diagnoses.CurrentChenP5U9UniformTaylorTail: The old internal equality is false: 32*(59/250-19/125)=336/125. Keep the original public 672/125 upper bound and use the nonnegative geometric tail to prove the internal weak inequality.
module_diagnoses.P5zUpsilon9OriginalRoute: Use abs_add_le for the two triangle inequalities and add_le_add_left for their right-added third term.
